The Failed U.N. COP31 Deal Reveals a New Reality for Climate Action

In the eleven years since the Paris Agreement , countries around the world have met annually to plot out the global consensus on how to tackle climate change. In some years negotiations led to big breakthroughs. In others, talks simply kept the ball in play, signaling to the world that nations were aligned in their desire to tackle climate change, even if it’s hard to agree on the exact path forward.
